item.title: Production, Investment, and Consumption See ‘Triple Decline’ in April…Impact of Iran War Becomes Visible (4월 생산·투자·소비 ‘트리플 감소’…이란 전쟁 여파 가시화)
item.description:
Production, consumption, and investment all fell last month. This ‘triple decline’ marks the first in eight months since August of last year. The aftermath of the US-Israel-Iran war appears to be taking full effect. (지난달 생산·소비·투자가 일제히 감소했다. ‘트리플 감소’는 지난해 8월 이후 8개월 만이다. 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 여파가 본격화한 것으로 보인다.)

According to the ‘April Industrial Activity Trends’ released by the National Data Service on the 29th, the overall industrial production index (seasonally adjusted, excluding agriculture and fisheries) stood at 117.8 (2020=100), down 0.6% from the previous month. Overall industrial production had increased by 2.1% in February and 0.4% in March but declined after three months. (국가데이터처가 29일 발표한 ‘4월 산업활동동향'을 보면, 지난달 전산업 생산지수(계절조정·농림어업 제외)는 117.8(2020년=100)으로, 전월보다 0.6% 감소했다. 전산업생산은 지난 2월 2.1%, 3월 0.4% 증가하다가 석달 만에 감소했다.)

Mining and manufacturing output fell by 0.7% from the previous month, largely due to a 19.4% drop in petroleum refining production. This is the largest decrease in 37 years and 11 months since May 1988 (-22.1%). It appears to be influenced by the difficult conditions in crude oil supply and demand caused by the US-Israel-Iran war. (광공업 생산은 전월보다 0.7% 줄었는데, 석유정제 생산이 19.4% 감소한 영향이 컸다. 1988년 5월(-22.1%) 이후 37년 11개월 만에 최대 폭 감소다. 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁으로 원유 수급 여건이 어려워진 영향으로 보인다.)

Automobile production also decreased by 10.0%, marking the largest decline in seven months since September of last year (-15.3%). Semiconductor production (3.1%), which is experiencing a super cycle, increased. (자동차 생산도 10.0% 줄었다. 지난해 9월(-15.3%) 이후 7개월 만에 감소 폭이 가장 컸다. 초호황(슈퍼 사이클)을 맞은 반도체(3.1%)는 생산이 늘었다.)

The retail sales index, reflecting consumption trends, fell 3.6% compared to the previous month. This is the largest drop in two years and two months since February 2024 (-3.7%). Durable goods consumption, including communication devices, computers, and passenger cars, fell 11.1% from the previous month, while non-durable goods such as vehicle fuels also decreased by 1.1%, influenced by measures like the two-car plate system for public institutions. Service industry production, indicating service consumption, also fell by 1.0%. (소비 동향을 보여주는 소매판매액 지수는 전월 대비 3.6% 감소했다. 2024년 2월(-3.7%) 이후 2년 2개월 만에 가장 크게 줄었다. 통신기기와 컴퓨터, 승용차 등 내구재 소비가 전월 대비 11.1% 감소한 가운데, 공공기관 차량 2부제 등 영향으로 차량 연료 등 비내구재도 1.1% 감소한 영향이 컸다. 서비스 소비를 보여주는 서비스업 생산도 1.0% 감소했다.)

Facility investment decreased by 3.6% from the previous month, and construction output (in constant prices), which reflects domestic construction performance by construction companies, also declined by 1.4%. (설비투자는 전월보다 3.6% 감소했고, 건설업체의 국내 시공 실적을 나타내는 건설기성(불변)도 1.4% 줄었다.)

The coincident composite index cyclical component, which shows the current economic situation, stood at 100.2, up 0.2 points from the previous month. The leading composite index cyclical component, which signals future economic trends, rose 0.6 points to 104.1. (현재 경기 상황을 보여주는 동행종합지수 순환변동치는 100.2로 전월 대비 0.2포인트 상승했다. 향후 경기 흐름을 예고하는 선행종합지수 순환변동치는 104.1로 0.6포인트 올랐다.)

Reporter Kim Yoon-joo kyj@hani.co.kr (김윤주 기자 kyj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: POSCO's Free Meal Center 'Nanum House' Continues for 22 Years... 'Black and White Chef' Meal Masters Join for Special Volunteer Service (22년째 이어온 포스코 무료급식소 ‘나눔의 집’…흑백요리사 급식대가와 특식 봉사 펼쳐)
item.description:
POSCO (CEO Lee Hee-geun) has been a steadfast pillar for the Pohang and Gwangyang communities since 2004, continuing its warm companionship for 22 years. ( 포스코(대표이사 이희근)가 지난 2004년부터 22년째 포항·광양 지역사회의 든든한 버팀목이 되어 따뜻한 동행을 이어오고 있다.)

POSCO operates a free meal center called 'Nanum House' for neighbors at risk of missing meals, such as elderly individuals living alone and people with disabilities. Currently, five 'Nanum Houses' in Pohang (Haedo, Songdo, Jecheol-dong) and Gwangyang (Gwangyeong, Taein-dong) have provided warm meals to an average of about 903 people per day, totaling 4.16 million people over the past 22 years. Beyond simply preventing hunger and alleviating nutritional imbalances, this place serves as a 'living room' where local seniors check on each other and communicate, and as a reliable 'rest area,' acting as a focal point for the community. <<> In particular, to mark the 22nd anniversary of the opening of 'Nanum House' this year, POSCO conducted a special meal service on the 21st at Songrim Senior Welfare Center in Songdo-dong. Songdo-dong holds a special connection with POSCO, as the Pohang Steelworks' Steelmaking Division has maintained a sisterhood relationship since 1994, consistently practicing neighborly love for over 30 years. <<> On that day, POSCO CEO Lee Hee-geun personally served meals to the seniors and encouraged the on-site volunteers who participated in the meal service. Notably, Chef Lee Mi-young, a 'Meal Master' from the popular cooking show 'Black and White Chef,' joined in, providing the seniors with nutritious special meals, offering warm comfort and a unique culinary experience. <<> CEO Lee Hee-geun stated, "The reason POSCO has been able to continue the warmth of sharing with the local community for 22 years is thanks to the unwavering trust of our neighbors," adding, "Going forward, POSCO will take the lead in practicing the value of sharing as a sturdy fence for the local community." <<> Chef Lee Mi-young, who participated in the volunteer work, also said, "I believe food goes beyond simply filling the stomach; it is a warm heart that connects people," and added, "Together with POSCO employees, I was able to reflect once again on the value of sharing by serving heartful meals to the seniors." <<> POSCO's sharing efforts also shone during times of crisis. Especially during the COVID-19 pandemic, it played the role of a sturdy pillar for the local community by providing lunch boxes and convenience foods to minimize meal service gaps. Additionally, as part of the POSCO 1% Sharing Foundation's 'Hope Space' project, it has repaired the roofs and electrical facilities of 'Nanum House' and replaced outdated signs and sheets to enhance the safety and convenience of users. <<> Meanwhile, beyond the 'Nanum House' free meal center, the POSCO Group continues to operate customized programs to address imbalances for marginalized groups, including future generations, multicultural families, and people with disabilities. POSCO plans to continue listening to the diverse voices of the local community and carry out field-oriented sharing activities that bring about practical changes where help is needed, going beyond simple support. <<> ( 포스코는 독거노인과 장애인 등 결식 우려 이웃을 위해 무료급식소 ‘나눔의 집’을 운영 중이다. 현재 포항(해도· 송도· 제철동)과 광양(광영· 태인동) 지역에서 운영하는 5개의 ‘나눔의 집’은 지난 22년간 일평균 약 903명, 누적 416만 명에게 따뜻한 한 끼를 제공해 왔다. 이곳은 단순한 결식 예방과 영양 불균형 완화를 넘어, 지역 어르신들이 서로 안부를 묻고 소통하는 ‘사랑방’이자 든든한 ‘쉼터’로서 지역사회의 구심점 역할도 하고 있다.)

item.title: Samsung Electronics Ships First 7th-Generation HBM Samples, Also Participates in Anthropic Investment (삼성전자, 7세대 HBM 샘플 첫 출하…앤트로픽 투자도 참여)
item.description:
Samsung Electronics is accelerating its market攻势 by shipping the industry's first samples of next-generation artificial intelligence (AI) memory. Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and others have also made strategic investments in the U.S. company Anthropic, the developer of the AI model 'Claude,' strengthening their collaboration. (삼성전자가 차세대 인공지능(AI) 메모리 샘플을 업계 최초로 출하하며 시장 공략에 속도를 내고 있다. 삼성전자·에스케이(SK)하이닉스 등은 인공지능(AI) 모델 ‘클로드’ 개발사인 미국 앤트로픽에도 전략적 투자를 단행하며 협력을 강화하고 나섰다.)

On the 29th, Samsung Electronics announced that it has shipped samples of the 7th-generation high-bandwidth memory (HBM4E) in a 12-layer stack. This follows the industry's first mass production and shipment of the previous 6th-generation product (HBM4) in February, showcasing a prototype for the next generation just three months later. (삼성전자는 7세대 고대역폭메모리(HBM4E) 12단 샘플을 출하했다고 29일 밝혔다. 앞서 지난 2월에 이전 세대인 6세대 제품(HBM4)을 업계에서 처음으로 양산 출하한 데 이어, 석 달 만에 다음 세대 시제품을 선보인 것이다.)

The 7th-generation high-bandwidth memory uses DRAM manufactured with a 10-nanometer (nm, where 1 nm is one-billionth of a meter) class 6th-generation (1c) fine process, along with a logic die produced using Samsung's own foundry (semiconductor contract manufacturing) 4-nanometer process. The logic die, located at the bottom of the vertically stacked DRAM chips, acts as a control center that manages data movement and regulation. (7세대 고대역폭메모리는 10나노미터(㎚·1나노미터는 10억분의 1m)급 6세대(1c) 미세 공정으로 만든 디(D)램과 삼성전자 자체 파운드리(반도체 수탁생산)의 4나노미터 공정을 통해 생산한 로직 다이를 적용했다. 수직으로 쌓아 올린 디램 칩들의 맨 아래에 위치한 로직 다이는 데이터 이동과 제어를 통제하는 관제 센터 구실을 한다.)

Through this, Samsung explained that the operating speed per pin (data transfer speed per pin) of the 7th-generation product is 14 to 16 Gbps (gigabits per second), an improvement of over 20% compared to the 6th generation. The capacity has also been increased to 48 GB (gigabytes), up more than 30% from the previous generation. (삼성전자는 이를 통해 7세대 제품의 핀당 동작 속도(핀당 데이터 전송 속도)가 14~16Gbps(초당 기가비트)로, 6세대에 견줘 20% 이상 향상됐다고 설명했다. 용량도 48GB(기가바이트)로 전작 대비 30% 이상 늘렸다.)

Samsung Electronics, along with SK Hynix and U.S. company Micron, has also participated in investments in U.S. company Anthropic. On the 28th (local time), Anthropic announced that it raised $65 billion in its pre-IPO investment round (Series H investment round), achieving a post-investment valuation of $965 billion. (삼성전자는 에스케이하이닉스, 미국 마이크론 등과 함께 미국 앤트로픽 투자에도 참여했다. 앤트로픽은 앞선 28일(현지시각) 진행한 상장 전 투자 유치 단계(시리즈H 투자 라운드)에서 650억달러를 유치하며 투자 후 기업가치 9650억달러를 평가받았다고 밝혔다.)

In this round, the 'big three memory companies'—Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and Micron—all participated as strategic infrastructure partners, making equity investments. Anthropic stated, "The technology of these companies plays a key role in the global supply of memory, storage devices, and logic chips (system semiconductors)," and added, "The collaboration with these companies will greatly help in stably expanding computing capacity to meet customer needs." (여기엔 삼성전자, 에스케이하이닉스, 마이크론 등 ‘메모리 3사’가 일제히 전략적 인프라 파트너로 지분 투자에 참여했다. 앤트로픽 쪽은 “이 기업들의 기술은 전 세계 메모리, 저장 장치, 로직 칩(시스템반도체) 공급에 핵심 역할을 담당하고 있다”며 “(이 기업들과의) 협력 관계는 고객 요구에 맞춰 컴퓨팅 역량을 안정적으로 확장하는 데 큰 도움이 될 것”이라고 설명했다.)

This has led to speculation that Samsung Electronics, which unlike other memory manufacturers has its own foundry capable of producing logic chips, could secure orders for AI chips that Anthropic will use in the future. (이를 두고 다른 메모리 제조사와 달리, 로직 칩을 생산할 수 있는 자체 파운드리를 보유한 삼성전자가 향후 앤트로픽이 사용할 인공지능 칩을 수주할 수 있다는 전망도 나온다.)

Reporter Park Jong-oh pjo2@hani.co.kr (박종오 기자 pjo2@hani.co.kr)

item.title: 'Up to 19.4% Annually' Youth Future Savings Account Launches on 22nd of Next Month... Application Period Until July 3rd (‘최고 연 19.4%’ 청년미래적금 내달 22일 출시…가입신청 7월3일까지)
item.description:
The 'Youth Future Savings Account,' which offers an annual interest rate of up to 7-8% to support asset formation among young people, will launch on the 22nd of next month. Considering bank interest rates along with government contributions and tax exemption on interest income, the effective interest yield reaches up to 13.2-14.4% annually for the standard type and 18.2-19.4% for the preferential type. (최고 연 7~8% 금리를 제공해 청년층 자산 형성을 지원하는 ‘청년미래적금’이 다음달 22일 출시된다. 은행 금리에 정부 기여금과 이자소득 비과세 혜택을 고려하면 실질 이자 효과는 일반형의 경우 최고 연 13.2~14.4%, 우대형은 최고 18.2~19.4% 수준에 이른다.)

According to a summary from the Financial Services Commission on the 29th, institutions handling the Youth Future Savings Account (14 entities including commercial banks, regional banks, and internet-only banks) disclosed interest rate details, including preferential rates, on the Korea Federation of Banks' consumer portal on that day. This product features a fixed interest rate over three years, offering a base rate of 5% plus an additional 2-3 percentage points in preferential rates from each institution, resulting in a maximum annual rate of 7-8%. The deposit limit is 6 million won per year (500,000 won per month), with a maximum total deposit of 18 million won over three years. (29일 금융위원회 설명을 종합하면, 청년미래적금 취급기관(시중·지방은행·인터넷전문은행 등 14곳)은 이날 우대금리 세부사항 등 금리 수준을 은행연합회 소비자포털에 공시했다. 청년미래적금은 3년 고정금리 상품으로, 기본금리 5%에 기관별 우대금리 2~3%포인트를 더해 최고 연 7~8% 수준의 금리를 제공한다. 납입한도는 연 600만원(월 50만원)으로 3년 가입 최대 금액은 1800만원이다.)

By institution, Nonghyup, Shinhan, Woori, Hana, IBK, Kookmin, and the Korea Post provide up to 3 percentage points in preferential interest rates. Suhyup, iM Bank, Busan Bank, Gwangju Bank, Jeonbuk Bank, Kyongnam Bank, and Kakao Bank offer up to 2 percentage points in preferential rates. (기관별로는 농협·신한·우리·하나·기업·국민·우정사업본부가 최대 3%p 우대 금리를 제공한다. 수협·아이엠(iM)·부산·광주·전북·경남·카카오의 우대금리는 최대 2%p다.)

Institution-specific preferential rates are applied differentially based on financial transaction performance and usage conditions, such as salary transfers and card usage. Common preferential rates across institutions include 0.5 percentage points for young people with total annual salary of 36 million won (or comprehensive income of 26 million won) or less, and 0.2 percentage points for those who complete the 'Financial Counseling for All Youth' program. The Financial Services Commission explained, "Considering bank interest rates along with government contributions and tax exemption on interest income, the effective yield for a subscriber is similar to signing up for a simple interest savings account with a maximum of 13.2-14.4% annually for the standard type and up to 18.2-19.4% for the preferential type." (기관별 우대금리는 급여 이체, 카드이용 등 금융거래 실적 및 이용 조건에 따라 차등 적용된다. 취급기관 공통 우대금리로는 총급여 3600만원(종합소득금액 2600만원) 이하 청년에 0.5%p, ‘청년 모두를 위한 재무상담’ 이수자에게 0.2%p가 제공된다. 금융위는 “은행 금리에 정부 기여금과 이자소득 비과세 혜택을 고려하면 실질 가입 효과는 일반형 기준 최고 13.2~14.4%, 우대형 기준 최고 18.2~19.4% 수준의 단리 적금 상품 가입하는 것과 유사하다”고 설명했다.)

For example, if the full deposit limit is met over three years at an 8% interest rate, the maturity payout for the standard type amounts to 21.38 million won (principal of 18 million won + government matching contribution of 1.08 million won + interest of 2.3 million won), equivalent to the effect of subscribing to a simple interest savings account with a 14.4% rate (principal of 18 million won + pre-tax interest of 4 million won - interest income tax of 620,000 won). Under the same conditions, the preferential type would yield a maturity payout of 22.55 million won (principal of 18 million won + government matching contribution of 2.16 million won + interest of 2.39 million won), equivalent to subscribing to a simple interest savings account with a 19.4% rate. (예컨대 금리 8%로 3년 납입한도를 모두 채웠을 경우, 만기 때 받는 금액은 일반형의 경우 2138만원(원금 1800만원+정부 매칭 기여금 108만원+이자 230만원)으로 금리 14.4%의 단리 적금상품에 가입한 효과(원금 1800만원+세전이자 400만원-이자소득세 62만원)를 보게 된다. 같은 조건으로 우대형은 만기 시 받는 금액이 2255만원(원금 1800만원+정부 매칭 기여금 216만원+이자 239만원)으로 금리 19.4%의 단리 적금상품에 가입하는 효과가 있다.)

The 14 institutions plan to launch the product simultaneously on June 22nd. The application period will run for two weeks, from the launch date until July 3rd. After applications are received, eligibility and income screening will proceed in sequence. In the first week, applications will be accepted on a five-day rotation based on the last digit of the applicant's birth year. In the following week, applications will be open regardless of the birth year. (14개 기관은 오는 6월22일 동시에 상품을 출시할 예정이다. 가입 신청 기간은 출시일부터 7월 3일까지 2주간 운영된다. 신청 접수 후 가입 및 소득 심사가 순차적으로 진행된다. 첫 주에는 출생연도 끝자리 기준으로 5부제 신청을 받는다. 그다음주에는 출생연도와 상관없이 가입 신청이 가능하다.)

It is also possible to switch from the Youth Leap Account to the Youth Future Savings Account through a special early withdrawal. (청년도약계좌 특별중도해지를 통해 청년미래적금으로 갈아타기도 가능하다.)

Senior Reporter Jo Gye-wan kyewan@hani.co.kr (조계완 선임기자 kyewan@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Anthropic's 'Valuation' Surpasses OpenAI at 1,447 Trillion Won... Secures 98 Trillion Won in Investment (앤트로픽 ‘몸값’ 1447조원, 오픈AI 제쳐…98조원 투자 유치)
item.description:
Generative AI developer Anthropic has surpassed rival OpenAI's corporate valuation in its latest funding round. (생성형 인공지능 개발사 앤트로픽이 신규 투자유치 과정에서 경쟁사 오픈에이아이(AI)의 기업가치를 뛰어넘었다.)

Anthropic announced on its blog on the 28th (local time) that it raised $65 billion (approximately 97.5 trillion won) in its recent Series H funding, and its post-investment valuation was assessed at $965 billion (approximately 1,447 trillion won). This is more than 2.5 times the valuation from its previous funding round in February ($380 billion) and $113 billion (approximately 169 trillion won) higher than its key competitor OpenAI's assessed valuation as of March ($852 billion). Anthropic also revealed that its monthly revenue, when annualized earlier this month, exceeded $47 billion in annual sales. This is nearly double the annualized revenue of OpenAI ($25 billion) as of February. (앤트로픽은 28일(현지시각) 자사 블로그에 최근 진행한 시리즈 에이치(H)펀딩에서 650억달러(97조5천억원 상당)를 유치했고, 투자 유치 뒤 기업 가치는 9650억달러(1447조원 상당)로 평가받았다고 밝혔다. 이는 지난 2월 투자유치 당시 받았던 기업가치(3800억달러)보다 2.5배 이상 늘어난 수치이자, 앤트로픽의 핵심 경쟁사인 오픈에이아이의 3월 기준 평가가치(8520억달러)보다도 1130억 달러(169조원 상당) 높다. 앤트로픽은 또 이달 초 월간 매출을 연간 기준으로 환산할 경우 연 매출액이 470억달러를 돌파했다고도 밝혔다. 이는 지난 2월 기준 오픈에이아이의 연환산 매출액(250억달러)보다도 2배 가까이 높다.)

Anthropic stated that Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and Micron also joined this investment round. Regarding these companies, Anthropic noted, "They play a critical role in the global supply of memory, storage, and logic chips" and added, "This partnership will help scale computing reliably at the speed our customers need." (앤트로픽은 이번 투자 라운드에는 삼성전자와 에스케이(SK)하이닉스, 마이크론도 합류했다고 밝혔다. 앤트로픽은 이들 회사를 두고 “전 세계의 메모리, 스토리지 및 로직 칩 공급에 핵심적인 역할을 한다”며 “이 파트너십은 고객이 필요로하는 속도에 맞춰 컴퓨팅을 안정적으로 확장하는 데 도움이 될 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, on the same day, Anthropic unveiled 'Opus 4.8,' a new version of its top public model 'Opus.' The company highlighted 'honesty' as the most notable improvement of this model. The probability of failing to point out flaws in its own code is four times lower than in the previous model. Additionally, benchmark scores comparing AI model performance outperformed rival OpenAI's Chat GPT-5.5 model or Google's Gemini Pro 3.1 in most metrics. (한편, 이날 앤트로픽은 자사 공개 모델 중 최상위 모델인 ‘오퍼스’의 새 버전인 ‘오퍼스 4.8’을 공개했다. 회사는 이번 모델의 가장 주목할 개선사항으로 ‘정직성’을 꼽았다. 기존 모델보다 자신이 작성한 코드의 결함을 지적하지 않고 넘어갈 확률이 이전 모델보다 4배 낮다. 인공지능 모델 성능을 비교하는 벤치마크 점수 또한 경쟁사인 오픈에이아이의 챗 지피티-5.5모델이나 구글의 제미나이 프로 3.1보다 대부분의 지표에서 앞섰다.)

item.title: Despite sharp increase in Seoul move-ins in April compared to previous month, volume halved from a year ago… Monthly rent share nears 70% (4월 서울 입주 전월 대비 급증에도 1년 새 ‘반토막’…월세 70% 육박)
item.description:
The volume of housing move-ins in Seoul last month improved compared to the previous month but was only half the level seen a year earlier. The proportion of monthly rent transactions among total rental deals reached 70%, maintaining a high level. (지난달 서울 주택 입주 물량이 전월보다는 개선됐으나 1년 전과 견줘 절반 수준에 그친 것으로 나타났다. 전체 임대차 거래 가운데 월세 비중은 70%에 이르며 높은 수준을 유지했다.)

According to the April housing statistics released by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport on the 29th, nationwide housing permits, including non-apartment units, totaled 29,242 households, up 51.3% from the previous month. Seoul (7,128 households) surged 292.7%, driving the overall increase. The Seoul metropolitan area (16,142 households) rose 67.7%, while non-metropolitan areas (13,100 households) increased 35.0%. Apartment permits nationwide (25,951 households) grew 62.7%, with Seoul (6,238 households) seeing a 520.7% jump. <<> Groundbreakings totaled 26,546 households, up 39.8% from the previous month. The Seoul metropolitan area (16,966 households) increased 170.1% over the same period, and Seoul (2,012 households) rose 62.4%. However, compared to the same month last year, the metropolitan area fell 7.6% and Seoul declined 45.5%. Non-metropolitan areas (9,580 households) recorded a 24.6% decrease from the previous month. Apartment groundbreakings nationwide stood at 23,406 households, up 48.0% from the previous month. <<> Sales of multi-unit dwellings reached 34,393 households, up 86.9% from the previous month. The Seoul metropolitan area as a whole (17,425 households) increased 90.1%, but Seoul (1,897 households) plunged 62.8%, a sharp decline. Instead, Gyeonggi Province (14,745 households) posted a high growth rate of 515.7%, lifting the metropolitan area average. However, compared to the same month last year, Seoul’s sales volume increased 369.9%. Non-metropolitan area sales totaled 16,968 households, up 83.8%. <<> Completion (move-in) volume reached 18,039 households, down 8.8% from the previous month. The Seoul metropolitan area (8,724 households) declined 20.6%, while Seoul (3,816 households) increased 105.1%. The year-over-year growth rate for the metropolitan area was -53.1% and for Seoul -55.5%, falling short of half the level from a year ago. Move-in volume in non-metropolitan areas stood at 9,315 households, up 5.9% from the previous month. Nationwide apartment completions (15,849 households) decreased 9.0% from the previous month. The metropolitan area (7,581 households) fell 22.2%, but Seoul (3,320 households) showed a high growth rate of 175.1%. However, compared to a year earlier, move-in volume declined 60.4% in Seoul and 57.2% in the metropolitan area. <<> Nationwide home sales transactions totaled 69,755 cases, down 3.1% from the previous month. The Seoul metropolitan area (38,468 cases) increased 6.8% over the same period, Seoul (12,745 cases) rose 15.8%, while non-metropolitan areas (31,287 cases) fell 13.0%. Apartment transaction volume (53,177 cases) decreased 6.1% from the previous month, but the metropolitan area (28,027 cases) rose 5.6% and Seoul (7,521 cases) increased 16.9%. <<> Rental transactions totaled 234,339 cases, down 16.2% from the previous month. Jeonse (73,883 cases) decreased 14.9% from the previous month and 19.5% from the same month last year, while monthly rent (including deposit-based monthly rent and half-jeonse) transactions (160,456 cases) fell 16.8% from March but increased 17.4% from a year earlier. Based on cumulative data from January to April, the proportion of monthly rent among total rental transactions stood at 68.5%, up 8.1 percentage points from a year ago. <<> Reporter Lee Ji-hye godot@hani.co.kr (국토교통부가 29일 발표한 4월 주택통계를 보면, 비아파트를 포함한 전국 주택인허가는 2만9242가구로 전월 대비 51.3% 증가했다. 서울(7128가구)이 292.7% 늘어 전체 증가세를 견인했다. 수도권(1만6142가구)은 67.7%, 비수도권(1만3100가구)은 35.0% 늘었다. 아파트 인허가는 서울(6238가구)이 520.7% 증가하는 등 전국(2만5951가구)에서 62.7% 늘었다.)

item.title: Chairman Lee Jae-yong Casts Early Vote on First Day... Unusual Media Exposure (이재용 회장, 첫날 사전투표…이례적 언론 노출)
item.description:
Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong visited the Hannam-dong Community Center in Yongsan-gu, Seoul on the 29th, the first day of early voting for the June 3 local elections, to cast his ballot. It was unusual for the media to capture Chairman Lee’s voting scene. (이재용 삼성전자 회장이 6·3지방선거 사전투표 첫날인 29일 서울 용산구 한남동 주민센터를 찾아 한 표를 행사했다. 이 회장의 투표 장면이 언론에 공개된 것은 이례적이다.)

Chairman Lee arrived at the early voting station set up at the Hannam-dong Community Center that morning. Wearing a gray suit, he was seen shaking hands with on-site staff while receiving the ballot paper, and this moment was captured by the media. (이 회장은 이날 오전 한남동 주민센터에 마련된 사전투표소를 찾았다. 그는 회색 정장 차림으로 기표용지를 건네받는 과정에서 현장 관계자와 악수를 하는 모습이 언론에 포착되기도 했다. )

Early voting for the 9th National Simultaneous Local Elections and by-elections for 14 National Assembly seats will be held for two days from the 29th to the 30th at 3,571 early voting stations nationwide, with voting hours from 6:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Voters can vote at any nearby early voting station without prior notification by presenting their resident registration card, passport, driver’s license, or other identification. The main voting day is June 3, and voting is only possible at designated polling stations. (제9회 전국동시지방선거 및 14곳의 국회의원 재·보궐선거의 사전투표는 이날부터 30일까지 이틀 동안 전국 3571개 사전투표소에서 실시되며, 투표 시간은 아침 6시부터 오후 6시까지다. 유권자는 별도의 신고 없이 주민등록증이나 여권, 운전면허증 등 신분증을 지참해 가까운 사전투표소에서 투표할 수 있다. 본투표는 6월3일 실시되며, 지정된 투표소에서만 투표가 가능하다.)

item.title: Bank Bad Loans Reach 17.7 Trillion Won… Individual Business Loan Delinquency Hits 11-Year High (은행 부실채권 17.7조…개인사업자 대출 부실 11년만 최고)
item.description:
As of the end of the first quarter, the domestic bank non-performing loan ratio (substandard or below loans) hit its highest level in five years. The delinquency ratio for individual business loans stood at 0.66%, the highest in 11 years. (지난 1분기 말 기준 국내은행의 부실채권비율(고정이하 여신)이 5년 만에 최고 수준을 기록했다. 개인사업자 대출 부실 비율은 0.66%로 11년만에 가장 높은 수준을 보였다.)

According to the Financial Supervisory Service on the 29th, the combined non-performing loan ratio of all domestic banks (commercial, regional, internet-only, and specialized banks) as of the end of March was 0.60% (total bad loans of 17.7 trillion won / total credit of 2,958.9 trillion won), up 0.03 percentage points from the end of last year (0.57%). This is the highest level in five years since the end of March 2021 (0.62%). (29일 금융감독원에 따르면, 국내 전체 은행(시중·지방·인터넷전문은행·특수은행)의 3월 말 합산 부실채권비율은 0.60%(부실채권 총액 17.7조원/총여신 2958.9조원)로 지난해 말(0.57%) 대비 0.03%포인트 상승했다. 이는 2021년 3월 말(0.62%) 이후 5년 만에 최고치다.)

The total amount of non-performing loans was 17.7 trillion won, an increase of 1.1 trillion won from the end of last year (16.6 trillion won). The scale of bad loans is the highest since March 2019 (18.5 trillion won). The breakdown was corporate loans (14.2 trillion won), household loans (3.3 trillion won), and credit card bonds (300 billion won). The FSS analyzed, "Due to factors such as a reduction in the scale of bad loan write-offs (including losses and sales) during the first quarter, the balance of non-performing loans increased, leading to a rise in the non-performing loan ratio compared to the end of last year." (부실채권액은 총 17조7천억원으로 지난해 말(16조6천억원)보다 1조1천억원 증가했다. 부실채권 규모는 2019년 3월(18조5천억원) 이후 최고치다. 기업여신(14조2천억원), 가계여신(3조3천억원), 신용카드채권(3천억원) 순이었다. 금감원은 “1분기 중 부실채권 정리 규모(대손상각·매각 등) 감소 등의 영향으로 부실채권 잔액이 증가하며 작년 말 대비 부실채권비율이 상승했다”고 분석했다.)

However, the new non-performing loans incurred in the first quarter amounted to 5.5 trillion won, down 400 billion won from the previous quarter. New non-performing corporate loans decreased by 300 billion won to 4.1 trillion won, and new non-performing household loans fell by 100 billion won to 1.3 trillion won. Yet, the non-performing loan ratio for individual business loans hit 0.66%, the highest in 11 years. (다만 1분기에 새로 발생한 부실채권은 5조5천억원으로 전분기 보다 4천억원 줄었다. 기업여신 신규부실은 4조1천억원으로 3천억원, 가계여신 신규부실은 1조3천억원으로 1천억원 감소했다. ­그러나 개인사업자 여신에서 부실채권 비율은 0.66%로 11년 만에 최고치를 기록했다.)

The scale of bad loan write-offs in the first quarter was tallied at 4.4 trillion won, a decrease of 1.3 trillion won from the fourth quarter of last year. The balance of loan-loss provisions (26.7 trillion won) remained at the level of the end of the previous quarter, but the loan-loss provision coverage ratio (150.4%), which divides the loan-loss provision balance by non-performing loans, fell by 9.9 percentage points. (1분기 부실채권 정리규모는 지난해 4분기보다 1조3천억원 감소한 4조4천억원으로 집계됐다. 대손충당금 잔액(26조7천억원)은 전분기말 수준을 유지했지만, 대손충당금 잔액을 부실채권으로 나눈 대손충당금적립률(150.4%)은 9.9%포인트 하락했다.)

Senior Reporter Jo Gye-wan kyewan@hani.co.kr (조계완 선임기자 kyewan@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Foreigners Own 108,000 Homes in Korea... Transactions in Gangnam and Yongsan Plunge 58% (외국인 보유 주택 10만8천 가구…강남·용산 거래 58% 급감)
item.description:
The number of domestic homes owned by foreigners has been tallied at approximately 108,000 units. After designating foreign land transaction permit zones in August of last year, foreigner home transactions in Seoul have significantly decreased. (외국인이 보유한 국내 주택 물량이 약 10만8천가구로 집계됐다. 지난해 8월 외국인 토지거래허가구역을 지정한 뒤, 외국인의 서울 주택 거래량은 크게 감소한 것으로 나타났다.)

According to the foreign land and housing ownership statistics released by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport on the 29th, as of December last year, foreigners owned 108,231 homes in South Korea, an 8.0% increase from the same month a year earlier. The proportion of foreign-owned homes among all domestic homes was 0.55%. (국토교통부가 29일 발표한 외국인 토지·주택 보유 통계를 보면, 지난해 12월 기준 외국인이 소유한 국내 주택은 10만8231가구로 1년 전 같은 달보다 8.0% 증가했다. 국내 전체 주택 가운데 외국인 소유 비율은 0.55%였다.)

By nationality, Chinese nationals owned the most homes at 61,439 units. This was followed by Americans with 23,187 homes, Canadians with 6,542, Taiwanese with 3,392, and Vietnamese with 2,028. However, among long-term foreign residents, the homeownership rate was highest for Americans (27.4%), followed by Canadians (24.3%), Australians (22.2%), Taiwanese (17.8%), and Chinese (7.5%). (국적별로는 중국인 보유 주택이 6만1439가구로 가장 많았다. 그 뒤는 미국인 2만3187가구, 캐나다 6542가구, 대만 3392가구, 베트남 2028가구 순이었다. 다만 장기체류 외국인 가운데 주택 소유자 비율은 미국인(27.4%)이 가장 많았고, 캐나다(24.3%), 호주(22.2%), 대만(17.8%), 중국인(7.5%) 순으로 나타났다.)

In terms of housing type, multi-unit dwellings such as apartments, townhouses, and multiplex homes accounted for the majority at 90,913 units, while detached homes totaled 9,218. Regarding the number of homes owned, 99,648 individuals (93.4%) held one home, 5,651 (5.3%) owned two homes, and 1,387 (1.3%) owned three or more. (주택 유형은 아파트와 연립·다세대 등 공동주택이 9만913가구로 대부분을 차지했고 단독주택은 9218가구였다. 보유 주택 수는 1채 보유자가 9만9648명(93.4%)으로 가장 많았고, 2채 보유자는 5651명(5.3%), 3채 이상은 1387명(1.3%)으로 집계됐다.)

However, after the government designated key areas in the Seoul metropolitan area as land transaction permit zones for foreigners in August last year to curb foreign speculation in domestic real estate, foreigner home transactions in the capital region saw a sharp decline. From September last year to April this year, foreigner home transactions in Seoul decreased by 44% compared to the same period the previous year. Notably, in Seoul's Gangnam 3 districts (Gangnam, Seocho, and Songpa) and Yongsan District, foreigner home transactions dropped by 58%, showing a steeper decline. By nationality, American home transactions in Seoul fell by 57%, while Chinese transactions decreased by 36%. In Gyeonggi Province and Incheon, foreigner transactions also fell by 23% and 30%, respectively. (다만 지난해 8월 정부가 외국인의 국내 부동산 투기 방지를 위해 수도권 주요 지역을 외국인 대상 토지거래허가구역으로 지정하면서 외국인의 수도권 주택 거래량은 크게 감소한 것으로 나타났다. 지난해 9월부터 올 4월까지 외국인의 서울 주택 거래량은 전년 동기 대비 44% 감소했다. 특히 서울에서 강남3구(강남·서초·송파구)와 용산구의 외국인 주택거래량은 58% 줄어 감소폭이 더 컸다. 국적별로 보면 미국인의 서울 주택 거래량은 57%, 중국인은 36% 각각 감소했다. 경기도와 인천에서도 외국인 거래량이 각각 23%, 30% 줄어든 것으로 집계됐다.)

The total land area owned by foreigners amounted to 207,176,000 square meters, a 0.9% increase from the end of the previous year, accounting for 0.27% of the total national land area. The publicly announced value of foreign-owned land was 34.1431 trillion won, up 2.0% from the previous year. By nationality, Americans held the largest share of land ownership at 53.6%, followed by Chinese (7.9%), Europeans (6.9%), and Japanese (6.0%). (외국인이 보유한 국내 토지면적은 2억717만6천㎡로 전년 말 대비 0.9% 증가했으며, 이는 전체 국토 면적의 0.27% 수준이다. 외국인 보유 토지의 공시지가는 34조1431억원으로 전년 대비 2.0% 늘었다. 국적별 토지 보유 비중은 미국이 53.6%로 가장 컸고, 중국(7.9%), 유럽(6.9%), 일본(6.0%) 등이 뒤를 이었다.)

By region, Gyeonggi Province accounted for the largest share of foreign-owned land area at 18.5%, followed by South Jeolla Province at 14.9%, and North Gyeongsang Province at 13.5%. By land use, other land types such as forests and farmland made up 68.1%, followed by factory sites at 21.7%, recreational land at 4.4%, and residential land at 4.2%. By ownership entity, foreign-national ethnic Koreans accounted for the largest share at 55.6%, followed by foreign corporations at 33.3%, pure foreigners at 10.9%, and government or organizations at 0.2%. (지역별로는 경기도가 외국인 보유 면적 중 18.5%로 가장 큰 비중을 차지했고, 전남 14.9%, 경북 13.5% 순이었다. 토지 용도는 임야·농지 등 기타용지가 68.1%로 가장 많았으며, 공장용지 21.7%, 레저용지 4.4%, 주거용지 4.2% 등이었다. 보유 주체별로는 외국 국적 교포가 55.6%로 가장 많았고, 외국 법인 33.3%, 순수외국인 10.9%, 정부·단체 0.2% 등의 순으로 나타났다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-hye godot@hani.co.kr (이지혜 기자 godot@hani.co.kr)

item.title: New Leap Fund Purchases Additional 960.2 Billion Won in Long-Term Delinquent Loans… 116,000 People ‘Stop Collection’ (새도약기금, 장기연체 9602억 추가 매입…11만6천명 ‘추심 중단’)
item.description:
The Financial Services Commission announced on the 29th that the New Leap Fund under the Korea Asset Management Corporation (KAMCO) has purchased 960.2 billion won worth of long-term delinquent bonds held by Nonghyup Asset Management Company, mutual finance sectors (Saemaul Geumgo, Suhyup, Shinhyup, and Forestry Cooperatives), private loan companies, and public institutions. (금융위원회는 한국자산관리공사(캠코)의 새도약기금이 농협자산관리회사, 상호금융권(새마을금고·수협·신협·산림조합), 대부회사, 공공기관 등이 보유한 장기 연체채권 9602억원어치를 매입했다고 29일 밝혔다.)

The 5th batch of purchased bonds consists of unsecured personal loans (including individual business owners) that have been overdue for over 7 years and are worth 50 million won or less, affecting 116,000 borrowers currently in arrears. Collection of these bonds will be halted immediately upon purchase. Among the purchased bonds, debts of socially vulnerable groups, such as basic livelihood security recipients, will be written off without a separate ability-to-repay assessment. (이번 5차 매입대상 채권은 7년 이상 연체, 5천만원 이하의 개인(개인사업자 포함) 무담보채권으로 11만6천명이 연체 중인 대출채권이다. 매입 즉시 추심은 중단되며, 매입채권 중 기초생활수급자 등 사회 취약계층 채무는 별도 상환능력 심사 없이 소각된다.)

For other purchased bonds, after a thorough assessment of repayment ability, those who have lost their repayment capacity to a level comparable to personal bankruptcy will be written off within one year, while those with significantly insufficient repayment capacity will undergo debt restructuring. The assessment of repayment ability is scheduled to begin in the third quarter of this year. (그 외 매입 채권은 철저하게 상환능력을 심사한 뒤 개인파산에 준하는 수준으로 상환능력을 상실한 경우 1년 이내 소각하고, 상환능력이 현저히 부족한 경우는 채무조정을 추진한다. 상환능력 심사는 오는 3분기 중 착수할 계획이다.)

The total amount of long-term delinquent bonds secured by the New Leap Fund through the 1st to 5th purchases stands at approximately 9.1 trillion won to date, benefiting around 750,000 people (including overlaps). The New Leap Fund plans to also purchase long-term delinquent bonds held by companies such as Sangnoksoo First Securitization Specialty Company, the Korea Federation of Credit Guarantee Foundations, Nonghyup, and private loan companies at the end of June. The Financial Services Commission stated, “We are conducting a full survey of the status of long-term delinquent bonds in the private loan sector. We are reviewing practical incentive measures to expand the participation of private loan companies in the New Leap Fund.” Currently, among the top 30 private loan companies (based on long-term delinquent bond holdings), 15 have signed the New Leap Fund agreement. (새도약기금이 1~5차 매입을 통해 확보한 장기연체채권은 현재까지 약 9조1천억원 규모이며, 수혜자는 약 75만명(중복 포함)이다. 새도약기금은 6월 말 상록수제일차유동화전문회사, 신용보증 재단중앙회, 농협, 대부회사 등이 보유한 장기연체채권도 매입할 예정이다. 금융위는 “대부업권에서도 장기 연체채권 보유 현황을 전수조사하고 있다. 대부회사의 새도약기금 참여 확대를 위한 실질적인 인센티브 방안을 검토하고 있다”고 했다. 현재 대부업권 상위 30개사(장기 연체채권 보유 기준) 중 새도약기금 협약에 가입한 회사는 15개사이다.)

item.title: Sharp Decline in Fixed-Rate Household Loans... Burden Amid Rising Rate Trend (가계대출 고정형 비중 대폭 하락...금리인상 기조 속 부담)
item.description:
The proportion of fixed-rate loans among household loans, including mortgage loans, has fallen to the 20% range. With market interest rates already on the rise and the Bank of Korea signaling a base rate hike, the household debt burden is expected to increase further. (주택담보대출을 비롯한 가계대출 중 고정금리 비중이 20%대로 떨어진 것으로 나타났다. 시장금리가 이미 오름세를 타고 있는 데다 한국은행이 기준금리 인상을 예고한 터여서 가계 빚 부담이 추가로 늘어날 것으로 보인다.)

According to the "Weighted Average Interest Rates of Financial Institutions" report released by the Bank of Korea on the 29th, the share of fixed-rate loans in new household lending fell by 7.7 percentage points from the previous month to 27.8%. This is the lowest level in 3 years and 9 months since July 2022 (21.4%). Among mortgages, the fixed-rate portion dropped from 60.8% in the previous month to 47.8%, also the lowest since July 2021 (43.9%). (한은이 29일 발표한 ‘4월 금융기관 가중평균금리’ 집계 결과를 보면, 신규취급액 기준 가계대출 중 고정금리 비중은 전달보다 7.7%포인트 떨어진 27.8%로 나타났다. 2022년 7월(21.4%) 이후 3년 9개월 만에 가장 낮은 수준이다. 주택담보대출 중 고정금리 비중은 전달 60.8%에서 47.8%로 떨어진 것으로 나타났다. 이 또한 2021년 7월(43.9%) 이후 최저 수준이다.)

The decline in fixed-rate loans indicates a rise in variable-rate loans, a factor that increases household burdens during a rate hike cycle. The Bank of Korea signaled a base rate hike in the second half of the year at its Monetary Policy Board meeting on the 28th, with two dissenting votes favoring a hike and an upward adjustment in the dot plot. Governor Shin Hyun-song also stated, "It is necessary to raise the base rate at an appropriate time." (고정형이 줄어든 것은 변동금리 비중이 높아졌다는 뜻이어서 금리 인상기에 가계 부담을 늘릴 요인이다. 한은은 28일 금융통화위원회에서 2명의 소수 인상 의견과 ’점도표’ 상향 조정을 통해 하반기 기준금리 인상 방침을 내비친 상태다. 신현송 한은 총재도 “적절한 시기에 기준금리를 인상할 필요가 있다”고 밝혔다.)

Regarding the expected increase in household debt burden, Lee Hye-young, head of the Financial Statistics Team at the Bank of Korea, said, "The reduction in fixed-rate loans is based on new lending volume, and the proportion based on outstanding balances is different, so the immediate impact on households will be limited." As of end-April, the fixed-rate share based on outstanding balances stood at 45.5% for general household loans and 64.4% for mortgages. (가계 빚 부담 증가 예상에 대해 이혜영 한은 금융통계팀장은 “신규취급액 기준으로 고정형이 줄어든 것이고 잔액 기준으로는 비중이 달라 당장 가계에 미칠 영향은 제한적일 것”이라고 말했다. 4월 말 현재 잔액 기준 고정형 비중은 일반 가계대출 45.5%, 주택담보대출 64.4% 수준이다.)

Household loan rates were recorded at 4.43%, slightly down from 4.51% in the previous month. This was attributed to a reduction in the share of relatively high-interest general credit loans. Mortgage rates fell by 0.03 percentage points to 4.31%, while guaranteed loan rates dropped by 0.11 percentage points to 4.10%. Corporate loan rates remained unchanged at 4.14%, with SME loan rates rising from 4.17% to 4.18% and large corporate loan rates falling from 4.11% to 4.09%. Overall loan rates stayed at 4.20%, matching the previous month, as corporate loans—which account for a large share—remained stable. (가계대출 금리는 4.43%로 전월(4.51%)보다 소폭 낮아진 것으로 집계됐다. 상대적으로 고금리인 일반 신용대출 비중이 축소된 데 따른 영향이다. 주택담보대출 금리는 0.03%포인트 떨어진 4.31%, 보증대출은 0.11%포인트 떨어진 4.10%였다. 기업대출 금리는 4.14%로 전월과 같은 수준을 유지한 가운데 중소기업 대출 금리는 4.17%에서 4.18%로 오르고, 대기업 대출 금리는 4.11%에서 4.09%로 떨어졌다. 큰 비중을 차지하는 기업대출이 보합세를 보인데 따라 전반적인 대출 금리는 전월과 같은 4.20%를 기록했다.)

In April, deposit banks' savings deposit rates rose by 0.10 percentage points to 2.92%, mainly driven by an increase in time deposit rates. Pure savings deposit rates, including time deposits, rose by 0.08 percentage points to 2.87%, while market-linked financial products such as certificates of deposit (CDs) and financial bonds increased by 0.09 percentage points to 3.07%. Deposit rates (based on one-year maturity time deposits) and loan rates (based on general loans) at non-bank financial institutions, including mutual savings banks, credit unions, mutual financial institutions, and community credit cooperatives, rose by 0.05 to 0.12 percentage points and 0.03 to 0.57 percentage points, respectively. (4월 중 예금은행의 저축성 수신금리는 전달보다 0.10%포인트 오른 2.92%로 집계됐다. 정기예금 금리 인상에서 주로 비롯됐다. 정기예금을 포함한 순수저축성예금 금리는 0.08%포인트 오른 2.87%, 양도성예금증서(CD)·금융채 등 시장형 금융상품 금리는 0.09%포인트 오른 3.07%로 나타났다. 상호저축은행, 신용협동조합, 상호금융, 새마을금고 등 비은행금융기관의 예금금리(1년 만기 정기예(탁)금 기준)와 대출금리(일반대출 기준)는 0.05∼0.12%포인트, 0.03∼0.57%포인트 상승한 것으로 나타났다.)

Senior Reporter Kim Young-bae kimyb@hani.co.kr (김영배 선임기자 kimyb@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Foreign Currency Deposits Turn to First Increase This Year (외화예금 올해 들어 첫 오름세 전환)
item.description:
Foreign currency deposits held by domestic residents, which had been on a steady decline since the start of the year, switched to an increase last month. (올들어 줄곧 감소세를 보이던 국내 거주자 외화예금이 지난달에 증가세로 돌아선 것으로 나타났다.)

According to data on "Resident Foreign Currency Deposit Trends" released by the Bank of Korea on the 29th, resident foreign currency deposits at foreign exchange banks totaled $110.68 billion as of the end of April, up $8.51 billion from the previous month. Resident foreign currency deposits refer to domestic foreign currency deposits held by local individuals, domestic companies, foreigners who have resided in Korea for more than six months, and foreign companies operating in Korea. These deposits had been declining consistently since the start of the year, with March recording a record monthly drop of $15.37 billion. (한국은행이 29일 발표한 ’거주자 외화예금 동향’ 자료를 보면, 4월 말 현재 외국환은행의 거주자 외화예금은 1106억8천만 달러로 전달에 견줘 85억1천만 달러 늘어난 것으로 집계됐다. 거주자 외화예금은 내국인과 국내 기업, 국내에 6개월 이상 거주한 외국인, 국내에 진출해 있는 외국 기업 등의 국내 외화예금을 말한다. 거주자 외화예금은 올해 들어 계속해서 줄었고, 지난 3월엔 153억7천만 달러로 월별 기준 역대 최대 감소 폭을 기록한 바 있다.)

The Bank of Korea analyzed that the shift to an increase in foreign currency deposits was primarily driven by "an increase in securities firms' investor deposits and inflows of funds for overseas investment execution by pension funds." A BOK official stated, "It appears that domestic investors holding dollar funds to purchase overseas stocks or not converting dollars received from selling overseas stocks contributed to the rise in foreign currency deposits." The official explained that the slight drop in the won-dollar exchange rate in April compared to March likely reduced demand for currency exchange. Receipts of current payments, such as export proceeds from large corporations, were also cited as a factor behind the increase. (한은은 외화예금 증가세 전환에 대해 “증권사의 투자자 예탁금 증가와 연기금의 해외투자 집행 자금 유입”에서 주로 비롯된 결과라고 분석했다. 한은 관계자는 “국내 투자자가 해외 주식을 사기 위해 달러 자금을 보유하고 있거나 해외 주식을 판 뒤 받은 달러화를 환전하지 않은 게 외화예금 증가로 이어진 것으로 보인다”고 말했다. 3월에 견줘 4월에 원-달러 환율이 약간 떨어져 환전 수요를 줄였을 것이란 설명이다. 대기업의 수출 대금 등 경상 대금 수취도 외화예금 증가 요인으로 꼽혔다.)

By currency, dollar deposits rose by $7.68 billion, while yen and euro deposits increased by $400 million and $260 million, respectively. By transaction type, corporate deposits grew by $8.08 billion to $94.88 billion, while individual deposits rose by $430 million to $15.8 billion. By bank type, domestic banks (with a deposit balance of $93.1 billion) saw an increase of $5.86 billion, while foreign bank branches ($17.58 billion) recorded a rise of $2.65 billion. (통화별로는 달러화 예금이 76억8천만 달러 늘고, 엔화와 유로화 예금은 각각 4억 달러, 2억6천만 달러 늘었다. 거래 주체별로는 기업 예금이 80억8천만 달러 늘어난 948억8천만 달러, 개인예금은 4억3천만 달러 증가한 158억 달러로 집계됐다. 은행별로는 국내 은행(예금 잔액 931억 달러) 58억6천만 달러, 외은 지점(175억8천만 달러)은 26억5천만달러 증가했다.)

Kim Young-bae, Senior Reporter kimyb@hani.co.kr (김영배 선임기자 kimyb@hani.co.kr)
